Definition: from G4862 and thlao (to crush); to dash together, i.e. shatter:--break.
BiblicalUsage: Whoever falls on this stone shall be broken, but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder. The stone is Christ, and the falling is the choice: fall on Him in repentance and be broken, or have Him fall on you in judgment and be ground to powder.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that falling on the stone in repentance is the only safe fall, and I hold that being broken by Him now is better than being ground to powder then.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
